objective: Evaluate September 2026 local open-weight image generation stacks to replace paid Kie cloud API on dual RTX 3090 24GB (sm_86), 32GB RAM, Linux exclusive creative mode, with programmatic txt2img + img2img/edit + ControlNet-class control via ComfyUI; compare Qwen-Image family, Z-Image-Turbo, FLUX.1/FLUX.2 variants, SDXL ControlNet/IP-Adapter, SD 3.5, and Krea-2; deliver day-1/day-7 install, multi-GPU pattern, licenses, pitfalls, checklist.
summary: Recommended Apache-first day-1 stack: ComfyUI dual workers (CUDA0:8188, CUDA1:8189) running FLUX.2-klein-4B (Apache, unified gen+edit, ~13GB VRAM; operator already has GGUF) plus Z-Image-Turbo 6B (Apache, 8-step, BF16 ~14-16GB). Day-7 add Qwen-Image-2512 + Qwen-Image-Edit (Apache, FP8/GGUF on 24GB) and SDXL ControlNet+IP-Adapter for structural control. Treat FLUX.1-dev/Fill/Kontext/Canny/Depth and FLUX.2-dev as non-commercial without paid BFL license (Fill already owned = R&D only). Krea-2 local weights exist but community license ≠ Apache. Prefer two workers over single multi-GPU process for throughput. Avoid Blackwell-only NVFP4 kernels on sm_86.

claims.statement: Qwen-Image-2512 and Qwen-Image-Edit are released under Apache-2.0.
Z-Image-Turbo is an Apache-2.0 ~6B distilled model with 8-step inference that fits ~14-16GB BF16.
FLUX.2-klein-4B is Apache-2.0, runs ~13GB VRAM, and unifies text-to-image with multi-reference editing.
FLUX.1 [dev], Fill, Depth, Canny, and Kontext are under FLUX.1 Non-Commercial License requiring BFL commercial license for commercial/production use.
FLUX.1-schnell is Apache-2.0 and suitable for a commercial-clean FLUX.1 path.
Krea-2 open weights (Raw and Turbo) exist on Hugging Face with ComfyUI support, under Krea community license rather than Apache.
Stable Diffusion 3.5 uses Stability Community License free for commercial use under $1M annual revenue.
SDXL under OpenRAIL++ remains the most mature ControlNet/IP-Adapter control ecosystem for local ComfyUI.
For dual 3090 API throughput, two independent ComfyUI workers outperform single-process multi-GPU for concurrent jobs.
Qwen-Image-Edit community VRAM tiers: FP8 ~20.5GB, BF16 ~40.9GB, GGUF Q4_K_M ~13.2GB.
FLUX.2-dev reports ~32.2B parameters and ~178GB total weight tree on HF — poor day-1 fit vs klein-4B.
Blackwell-oriented NVFP4 packs should be avoided on RTX 3090 sm_86; use Ampere-compatible torch/attention builds.
